launch.title: Launch a token

launch.createCtaBody: Name it, fund it, and hand it over in one step.
launch.empty: You have not launched a token yet.
launch.formSubtitle: Everything below is written into the ledger canister and cannot be edited afterwards.
launch.supplyHint: Minted once, to you, at launch. The minting account is then unreachable, so no more can ever be created.
launch.logoTooLarge: That image is too detailed to store on-chain. Try a simpler one.

launch.immutableBody: Nobody, including you, can ever change this token's code. The supply is minted once at launch and the minting account is set to the management canister, which nothing can call, so no more can ever be created.
launch.immutableProof: This token has no controller, and its minting account is aaaaa-aa. Call icrc1_minting_account on the ledger to see it yourself — that is what makes the supply fixed, not our word for it.
launch.upgradeableBody: You keep control and can upgrade it later. ICPay will not list it for sending.
launch.insufficient: You need {total} ICP in your wallet to launch.
launch.notReady: Token creation is unavailable right now. No launch can be paid for until it is back.
launch.confirmBody: The fee is charged before the ledger canister is created, and nothing about a launch can be undone.

launch.confirmUpgradeableWarning: You will keep control of this token, so ICPay will not list it for sending. Check the name, symbol and supply now.

icpayToken.title: ICPAY Token
icpayToken.subtitle: Live market data for ICPay's own token
icpayToken.marketUnavailable: Market data is unavailable right now.
icpayToken.priceInfo: Last traded USD price from the ICPAY/ICP pool on ICPSwap (api.icpswap.com). This is the market price, not the presale rate.
icpayToken.fdvInfo:
FDV = total supply × price

Total supply is read live from the ICPAY ledger (icrc1_total_supply). Price is the ICPSwap USD quote above.

Formula: (supply ÷ 10^decimals) × priceUsd
icpayToken.tvlInfo: Total value locked in the ICPAY/ICP liquidity pool on ICPSwap, in USD. Source: api.icpswap.com.
icpayToken.supplyInfo: Live on-chain total from the ICPAY ledger canister (icrc1_total_supply). Includes every account; fees burned reduce this over time.
icpayToken.change24hInfo: Percent change in the ICPSwap USD price over the last 24 hours. Source: api.icpswap.com.
icpayToken.volume24hInfo: USD trading volume in the ICPAY/ICP pool over the last 24 hours. Source: api.icpswap.com.
icpayToken.mintingInfo: ICRC-1 minting principal read from the ledger. If it is not aaaaa-aa, new supply can still be minted. ICPAY launched before ICPay locked minting to the management canister.

buyIcpay.title: Buy ICPAY
buyIcpay.heroSubtitle: Early access before the DEX launch
buyIcpay.guideStep1Body: Buy ICPAY at a fixed rate with ICP from your ICPay wallet. Tokens land in your account as soon as the purchase confirms.
buyIcpay.guideStep2Body: When the presale ends, every ICP raised is paired with ICPAY and added to the ICPSwap pool at the same rate — early buyers are not left underwater.
buyIcpay.guideStep3Body: ICPAY holders can claim premium usernames on ICPay — shorter handles, verified badges, and priority across the app.
buyIcpay.guideStep4Body: Pick an amount between 0.1 and 50 ICP per purchase, review the quote, and confirm. You can buy again anytime while inventory lasts.
buyIcpay.pageSubtitle: Pay with ICP from your ICPay wallet
buyIcpay.loginRequired: Sign in with Internet Identity to purchase ICPAY from the presale.
buyIcpay.externalWarning: ICPAY sent to an external principal leaves ICPay custody permanently. A typo is a total loss.
buyIcpay.rateInfo:
1 ICP = 20,000 ICPAY

Set in the ICPay canister. You receive exactly: ICP paid × 20,000 (both tokens use 8 decimals).

Example: 1 ICP → 20,000 ICPAY
buyIcpay.liquidityInfo: When the presale ends, 100% of the ICP raised is paired with ICPAY and seeded into the ICPSwap liquidity pool at the same presale rate.
buyIcpay.disclosureInfo: ICPAY's minting account is a live key — supply is not fixed and more tokens can be issued. Always verify icrc1_total_supply and icrc1_minting_account on the ledger before you buy.
buyIcpay.progressInfo:
Sold = presale cap − remaining inventory.

Cap is 10,000,000 ICPAY. Remaining is the live balance in the canister sale subaccount on the ICPAY ledger.

ICP raised = ICPAY sold ÷ 20,000.

bucket.docsStorageBody: Buckets are paid monthly from your ICPay balance. Files stay encrypted at rest on the canister.
bucket.docsImagesOnly: Images, documents, code, archives, audio, and fonts (see Pricing for the full list).
bucket.docsWebpNote: Native format up to 10 MB. Large files are chunked automatically (IC ingress limit is 2 MiB per call).
bucket.docsEncrypted: Encrypted at rest with per-bucket keys
bucket.docsTiersBody: Prices are fetched live from the canister — cycle cost plus 20% margin, rounded to 0.5 ICP steps.
bucket.pricingSubtitle: Simple, transparent pricing. Pay with ICP — billed every 30 days.
bucket.pricingBreakdownNote: Actual cost is the cycle equivalent for 30 days of reserved capacity. Price includes a 20% margin and is rounded to the nearest 0.5 ICP. Strikethrough shows the previous list price. Checkout always uses the live canister quote.
bucket.pricingFooter: Files stay on-chain in encrypted form. When a plan expires the bucket becomes read-only until you renew.
bucket.docsCdnBody: Public buckets expose copyable links on the IC raw HTTP gateway (per-canister host):
bucket.docsCdnOption: A Raw / CDN toggle on the bucket page switches between the canister host and the cloud.icpay.app CDN (when enabled).
bucket.docsCdnPrivate: Private buckets have no public URL — download with downloadFile while signed in.
bucket.docsApiBody: Call these update/query methods on the ICPay backend canister with Internet Identity or a bucket API key:
bucket.docsApiCanister: Canister ID: {id}. Sign in through ICPay or use @dfinity/agent with your Internet Identity delegation.
bucket.docsAuthBody: Bucket owner calls use your Internet Identity principal. API keys add read, write, or delete scopes — pass the secret as the optional apiKey argument. bucketId accepts the public bucket name or internal id.
bucket.docsUploadChunkTitle: Upload — single call and chunked sessions
bucket.docsReadTitle: Read — CDN GET, download, list, search
bucket.docsBulkBody: Up to 20 paths or move/copy operations per call.
bucket.docsApiKeysBody: Create keys in the bucket detail page. Read keys work on listFiles, downloadFile, getFile, and search. Write keys cover uploads and file updates. Delete keys cover deleteFile and bulkDeleteFiles.
bucket.docsPaginationBody: Files load {size} per page from the canister to keep queries fast.
